reasoning: I read panel.png at unchanged native resolution before consulting candidate files. The only eligible series is the blue CO2 195K open-circle/solid-line curve; the coral N2 77K series and the masked inset are excluded from coordinate export. Native tick centres agree with the supplied linear calibration to within its reported sub-pixel residuals, so the calibration was preserved and all final data values were recomputed from source pixels. Row-by-row overlay review found three omitted, clearly ring-supported CO2 centres near (157,292), (160,285), and (163,277), one partial ring needing recentering near (150,404), and thirteen automatic candidate centres inside fully fused blue bands without a separable centre or uniquely attributable arc. Those unsupported rows were deleted rather than justified from expected counts or interpolation. The CSV was written, reloaded, and used to generate a reconstruction and native overlay; the retained/added centres align with visible rings, while two fused low-pressure regions remain unresolved.

x.reason: Native x ticks read 0.0 to 1.0 at approximately 150, 246, 343, 440, 537, and 634 px. Reloaded points overlay the source at the same relative-pressure positions; the slight negative minimum is the calibrated centre of the x≈0 marker.

y.reason: Native y ticks read 0 to 140 cm³ g⁻¹ at approximately 468, 411, 354, 297, 240, 182, 126, and 68 px. The reloaded reconstruction places the rise and plateau at the source values, about 0–126 cm³ g⁻¹.

independent_read.y_axis: Uptake (cm³ g⁻¹), linear; printed major ticks 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140.

series.label: CO2 195K
series.notes: Blue/violet open circles joined by a solid blue line. Approximately 48 centres are separately visible or supported by identifiable partial rings; additional low-pressure ink is fused and not countable as distinct centres.

series.label: N2 77K
series.notes: Coral/red open circles joined by a solid coral line near zero uptake; excluded because the target policy/spec permits only CO2 rows.

visual_risks: The CO2 low-pressure rise contains vertically fused open circles; large native regions have no separable centre despite abundant blue pixels.
The first CO2 point overlaps the excluded N2 series near the origin.
The inset duplicates/contextualizes part of the curve and contains red highlighted markers; its mask [247,173,540,440] was inspected only as excluded context.
The upper-right and lower-right direct labels overlap nearby plot space but do not obscure the accepted plateau centres.

series.label: CO2 195K
series.comment: 48 source-supported visible or partial CO2 centres. Two native fused low-pressure regions remain unresolved; no wholly hidden points were exported.

uncertainties: Added native-visible centres at (157,292), (160,285), and (163,277) carry 1.5–1.75 px radial uncertainty, projected into uncertainty_x/y with the preserved calibration.
Moved partial centre at (150,404) carries 2.5 px radial uncertainty because only a white-centre sliver and partial ring arc remain visible.
Some unchanged candidate rows in overlapping but still identifiable rings retain their prior evidence metadata; no expected-count or interpolation-only rows were added.
Temporary reconstruction and overlay were generated from the reloaded /mnt/data/agent04_points.csv and visually checked against panel.png.
